source_message.text:
Please handle the remaining work as a six-stage page update:

1\. Pricing layout — Take out the most expensive pricing panel, leaving 2 panels. If the removal creates excessive empty space along the sides, restyle the section as needed. Every displayed option is a monthly pricing option, so render the 月 marker in smaller print than the price. The attached English reference image, in which “mo” appears smaller than the price, shows the intended treatment.

2\. q&a cleanup — Delete the penultimate box. This is the box directly above the final one asking what I should do if I have any questions.

3\. Duplication point — After the removals and styling changes above are complete, duplicate the page.

4\. Duplicate-only edit — Remove the pricing section entirely from that duplicate.

5\. Added controls — Place a secondary button beneath every button that was originally above the pricing panel. The secondary button should read 👇跳到課程內容介紹👇

6\. Secondary-button treatment — Leave this secondary button without a button wrapper. Use the attached “secondary\_button” image as its styling reference, but change the example’s placement: our secondary button belongs directly below the primary button rather than beside it.

routing_warnings.description: The message claims that the duplicate page is available but does not state or demonstrate that its pricing section was removed.
